svg.text: BIAS_GEN_V2 - CONSTANT-GM BETA-MULTIPLIER BIAS GENERATOR, CURRENT OUTPUTS (8-bit ADC)
WHAT Reference current for the 8-bit bottom-plate ADC. An NMOS-defined beta multiplier sets one core current;
mirrors hand it out as CURRENTS (no shared bias voltage leaves the block).
PINS vdd / vss: 3.3 V analog supply (AVDD); 45.6 uA from vdd at the bench, incl. the two midref currents.
icmp0..3: SINK 3.25 uA each, into each comparator's own pbias diode (1.68 x its 1.93 uA design bias, ADR 0017).
iramp: SINK 3.257 uA into the ramp's pbias diode (nominal 3.1314 uA).
ivref: SOURCE 11.2 uA into midref_buf ib (0.90 x its 12.36 uA bench current); ivbl / XOB removed (v5).
CORE XMN1 diode + XMN2 (K = 8 x XMN1) degenerated by R = 5 ppolyf_u strips (20.42 kOhm), 1:1 PMOS mirror XMP1 / XMP2;
moderate / weak inversion, so the current goes as about T / R.
CHOICES every MOS L 0.9 um, finger W 4 um; one PMOS row over one NMOS row, even finger counts, common centroid;
ppolyf_u for its flat TC; untrimmed: the comparator current meets comparator's requirement x (1 + 3 sigma)
at all 135 PVT cells; startup bleeder XSB1..4 + kick XSU5, released by XSU4; 1 pF MIM decaps on pb and nb.
NETLIST bias_gen.spice, GENERATED by size_bg.py; this drawing by bias_gen_sch.py.
VALUES ON THIS SHEET (layer-4 tags): ngspice at the block's OWN bench bias, typical / 27 C / res_typical / 3.3 V,
every consumer diode as load (verify_bg.py opdev -> data/op_devices.csv, op_passives.csv).
R and C: PDK-model replicas (R = 0.1 V / I; C from the AC current at 1 MHz).
gm/Id = gm / Id of the BSIM4 instance; Id includes m. In analog_top the loads and biases differ:
in-macro values are measured there, not here.
DEVICE OPERATING POINT AT THE BENCH BIAS
typical / 27 C / res_typical / 3.3 V, ngspice (verify_bg.py opdev -> data/op_devices.csv, op_passives.csv)
core, K x XMN1, on R
XR1..XR5 ppolyf_u W 1u L 10.7324u: 4.084 kOhm each, string 20.42 kOhm
XCP (pb-vdd), XCN (nb-vss) cap_mim_2f0 22.3607u x 22.3607u: 1016.4 fF each
card check: 1.99 fF/um2 x 500.0 um2 + 0.2383 fF/um x 89.4 um = 1016.3 fF
nodes: ns 69.7 mV, nb 0.626 V, pb 2.515 V
BIAS_GEN_V2S = bias_gen (this sheet, ../bias_gen/bias_gen.sch, ADR 0017) WITHOUT XOB / ivbl (the second
VDD/2 buffer's bias, gone with that buffer in Analog_top, ADR 0021) + ONE output added in Analog_top_v4: XOL, 6 fingers of the 4 um x 0.9 um PMOS on pb, SOURCES ivrlo into vrlo_ref's NMOS diode
(its ib, 1.37 uA design bias; 6/44 of ivref = 1.53 uA = 1.12x, inside vrlo_ref's verified 0.69-1.77x span).
Ports: bias_gen's - ivbl + ivrlo (9th). Every other device, value and note on this sheet is bias_gen's;
the floorplan's PMOS row (120 of 136 fingers used) has room for the 6 fingers. Drawn by analog_top_sch.py.
